text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali chaired a meeting of the Army High Council on Friday. Celebrations marking Tunisian army's 41st anniversary to be held on June 24.
- Tunisia aims at reaching self-sufficiency in main commodities, agriculture minister says.
- Tunisia ready to participate in future United Nations humanitarian missions.
- Agriculture Minister Mabrouk Bahri said on Friday cereals production was expected to be moderate.
Exports of olive oil rose during the first four months of 1997.
